svg.text: Lh, Rh = ~1 m harness (not on PCB)
TPS62933F buck: 12 V -> 6 V, start-up with a 1 A load. Values = LCSC BOM.csv
.save V(vout) V(vin) V(sw) V(ss) V(en) V(bst) V(fb) I(L1) I(Rh)
.meas tran vout_avg AVG V(vout) FROM 8m TO 9m
.meas tran vout_pp PP V(vout) FROM 8.5m TO 9m
.meas tran il_pp PP I(L1) FROM 8.5m TO 9m
.meas tran pin AVG V(vin)*I(Rh) FROM 8m TO 9m
.meas tran pout AVG V(vout)*V(vout)/6 FROM 8m TO 9m
